title: Generation and Verification: Human-Agent Collaboration for Safety-Critical Automotive Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.35982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Research on coding agents mainly focuses on generation quality. Yet, safety-critical automotive software makes two additional demands. It prioritizes verification, since every change is reviewed, traced to a requirement, and checked against industry standards such as MISRA and AUTOSAR before it can be committed. It is also a narrow domain, written against layered architectures, embedded resource constraints, and organization-specific interface conventions that are scarce in the data general-purpose LLMs are trained on. We present a coding assistant for automotive C/C++ that addresses both demands. First, it exposes three tools to the user over the Model Context Protocol (generate, edit, and verify), allowing developers to run verify on any code on demand rather than relying on the agent to check its own output. Second, rather than using a general-purpose model, we customize the underlying LLM for the automotive domain through prompt en

translated_title: 生成与验证：面向安全关键汽车软件工程的人机智能体协作
translated_abstract: 有关编程智能体的研究主要聚焦于生成质量。然而，安全关键的汽车软件提出了两项额外要求。其一，它高度重视验证，因为每一处代码变更都必须经过审查、追溯到需求，并通过 MISRA 和 AUTOSAR 等行业标准的检查后才能提交。其二，它是一个狭窄的领域，代码需遵循分层架构、嵌入式资源约束以及组织特定的接口规范，而这些内容在通用大语言模型（LLM）的训练数据中十分稀缺。我们提出一个面向汽车 C/C++ 的编程助手，以同时应对这两项要求。首先，它通过模型上下文协议向用户开放三个工具（生成、编辑和验证），使开发者能够按需对任意代码运行验证，而不必依赖智能体自行检查其输出。其次，我们不使用通用模型，而是通过提示工程等方式针对汽车领域对底层大语言模型进行定制（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一个面向安全关键汽车 C/C++ 软件的编程助手，通过 MCP 协议向开发者开放生成、编辑、验证三个可按需调用的工具以实现人机协作验证，并针对汽车领域定制底层大语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a coding assistant for safety-critical automotive C/C++ software that exposes generate, edit, and verify tools to developers on demand via the Model Context Protocol for human-agent collaborative verification, while customizing the underlying LLM for the automotive domain.
